metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Poké-POWER — Golden Wing

If Ho-Oh ex would be Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, you may move up to 2 Energy attached to Ho-Oh ex to your Pokémon in any way you like.

Pokémon-EX rule — When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

metadata.name: Attack 1
metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[3] Rainbow Burn (10+)

Does 10 damage plus 20 more damage for each type of basic Energy card attached to Ho-oh ex.
